games.title: Wildlings
games.fullTitle: Wildlings: Why is There a Zoo in Bazooka
games.role: Concept, game design, level design, dev
games.blurb: Blast yourself across one giant level with a bazooka. No jumps. Just recoil, traps and bad decisions.
games.description: Blast yourself with a bazooka across one giant rage-filled level in this brutal physics platformer. Mix and match animal heads and bodies, master precision recoil, and survive deadly traps. No mercy. No jumps. Just you, a bazooka, and bad decisions.

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: Designed the unique bazooka-based physics mechanics and challenging level structure

contributions.title: Unity Development
contributions.text: Implemented the core gameplay systems and physics interactions

contributions.title: UI Design
contributions.text: Created an engaging and intuitive user interface for the game

games.title: Ant March Adventure
games.blurb: Lead a growing ant colony through 10 randomised levels. Every run, every choice, a different colony.
games.description: Roguelike mobile game where players lead a growing ant colony through 10 randomized, increasingly difficult levels. Command your ant army as you navigate through procedurally generated environments, collecting resources and facing escalating challenges. Each run offers a unique experience with strategic decisions that determine the survival and growth of your colony.

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: Designed the core systems and mechanics that make each run unique and engaging

contributions.title: Lead Development
contributions.text: Mentored and directed the development team to bring the vision to life

contributions.title: UI/UX Design
contributions.text: Crafted an intuitive and accessible interface for mobile players

games.title: Road Rush Puzzle
games.blurb: Lay road tiles fast enough to keep a speeding car alive. Quick thinking, spatial puzzles, a ticking clock.

media.storeVideo: none found on Play Store or App Store listing (checked 20 Oct)

games.description: Fast-paced puzzle game where players build roads to guide a speeding car to its destination. Test your quick thinking and spatial awareness as you strategically place road tiles to create the perfect path. Race against time and overcome challenging obstacles to complete each level and master the art of road building.

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: Designed the core gameplay mechanics and progression systems

contributions.title: 3D Art
contributions.text: Created all visual assets to bring the game world to life

contributions.title: UI/UX Design
contributions.text: Crafted an intuitive and engaging user experience

games.title: Zen Puzzle Saga
games.blurb: Two orbs, Yin and Yang, move as mirror images with every swipe. Guide both past spikes and traps until they meet.
games.description: Welcome to Zen Puzzle Saga – the relaxing yet challenging puzzle game! Step into a world of balance, where Yin & Yang orbs move in perfect reflection every time you swipe. Guide these twin orbs through spiked edges, tricky walls, and cunning traps until they unite on the sacred Harmony tile.

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: Crafted the core mirror-movement mechanic and level progression, balancing puzzle difficulty from beginner to expert.
bullets: Designed mirrored orb controls and reflection rules

contributions.title: Game Art
contributions.text: Established a minimalist “Zen” aesthetic—clean lines, calming color palette, and ambient UI—to enhance focus and relaxation.
bullets: Created tilemap assets and UI icons
Composed subtle animations for smooth feedback

contributions.title: Sound Design
contributions.text: Created the music from scratch with a relaxing mood.

games.title: Sweet Shot
games.blurb: Guide candies from the factory pipeline into the jar. Every level adds a new obstacle to time and outsmart.
games.description: Hyper casual game with puzzle elements made for mobile. Step into the world of candy making, where you control the flow of delicious candies from the factory pipeline to the jar. Guide colorful candies through tricky factory pipelines and land them perfectly in the jar. But beware-each level is filled with unique challenges and obstacles that test your strategy and timing!

contributions.title: Unity Development
contributions.text: The game has some unique mechanics that I loved to implement

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: I loved designing the levels for this game as it challenged me to create a immersive flow throughout

games.title: Storm Alert
games.status: Proof of concept, University of Tartu
games.blurb: Your home, right before a real crisis. Gather supplies, decide under pressure, and work out who to call when things go wrong.

media.artNote: 1 = key art illustration; 2-9 = gameplay screenshots from Ahmed (21 Oct)

games.description: An interactive narrative about emergency preparedness that puts you at home right before a real crisis. Gather supplies, make decisions under pressure, and figure out who to call when things go wrong. Your choices determine how you and your household make it through the storm.

games.title: Magic Mineral
games.role: Concept, design, art direction, Unity dev
games.blurb: A dark cave, a dimming light, and magic that both helps and haunts you. Find the crystal that could save your village.
games.description: Explore the dangerous cave with very limited dimming light and experience the magic that both helps and haunts you. A top-down 2D survival game where you need to find a magic crystal that can potentially save your village.

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: This is an ongoing project but the overall design of the enemies and player abilities have been finalised.
bullets: Enemy Behavior and Player Ability Design

contributions.title: Game Art
contributions.text: This was the most interesting and my favourite part of the contribution. I wanted to maintain a unique look to the overall game and create the scary dungeon vibe with the lights and darkness.
bullets: Shader Creation using Unity Shader Graph

contributions.title: Programming (Unity)
contributions.text: Programming wise this is a very demanding job considering the scale of the game. I have already designed and developed the main systems but need to implement the rest of the enemies.

games.title: The Unwanted
games.role: Concept, narrative, hand-drawn art, Unity dev
games.blurb: Take a helpless ghost back to the forest, past every challenge on the way.
games.description: Can you take the helpless ghost back to the forest and pass all the challenges on the way? A point-and-click adventure game made as a project for the Advance Game Development course in the Digital Learning Games program, at Tallinn University.

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: The main objective of this game was to design a point and click adventure with puzzle element. The narrative of this game is very close to me.

contributions.title: Game Art
contributions.text: The game art was developed from scratch and I tried to maintain a stylized and personal look to the overall game as the game is trying to tell an emotional story. That's why I have chosen te hand drawn style

contributions.title: Programming (Unity)
contributions.text: Implementing the logic for this game was very simple, but the requirement was to make the game persistent through scenes. I have learned some advanced architecture during this game.

games.title: After the End
games.blurb: Humans left a dead Earth behind. As one of the last bees, pollinate what you can and dodge acid rain and mutants.
games.description: Submitted to Ludum Dare 53 Game Jam The humans have left the Earth leaving a dead planet behind. The few surviving plants and animals are now dying due to high level of pollution. Yet, hope remains. You are one of the last surviving bees of the planet, searching for other members of your tribe, are they alive? For your survival you can pollinate as many flowers as you can so the plants can repopulate and fix the Earth. But be aware! Earth is not what it was before, it's filled with pollutants, acid rain and mutant species. Do not spend too much time in the polluted area, come out for fresh air

games.title: The Return
games.status: Game jam: Global Game Jam, Pärnu
games.blurb: A journey where mother nature waits for "The Run" to return to its roots.
games.description: “Embark on a journey where mother nature awaits “The Run” to arrive at their roots” A game jam project submitted on Global Game Jam, Pärnu, 2023

games.title: Eat the Rich
games.blurb: A party card game about inequality. You are a PR manager hiding your rich client's dirty secrets, while the Hungry Crowd asks questions until someone ends up in the soup.
games.description: Made in a five-day game jam at the Un-Jam workshop, hosted by the Nordic Alliance for Sustainability in Gaming (NASG) in Copenhagen, by a team of five students from different backgrounds. The aim: draw attention to inequality, provoke discussion and ridicule the situation through a fun party game. You play a PR manager trying to hide the terrible truths about your rich client. The Hungry Crowd asks questions to bring the dirty secrets out, and finally throws your Rich into the soup.

games.title: Space Cricket
games.blurb: A cricket bat spinning in space. One tap flips its direction; time it to smash the right score and dodge the red stumps.
games.description: A simple casual game made for mobile. There is a bat in space, unlike normal cricket bat it’s rotating constantly. However, you can change the direction of rotation by a quick single tap. Timing of your tap is important to swing the bat to hit the target color score. Each color bar represents a unique cricket score. Be careful of the nasty red color stumps. On hitting those you’ll loose wicket. Smashing boundary enables exciting power-ups and increase your trophies. So swing your bat accordingly and try to hit the target of boundary.

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: I loved designing this game because of it's simplicity but yet the ability to immerse certain types of audience who loves challenge. The game balancing was also a fun part of designing the game as it involved lots of Playtesting session

games.title: Toony Car
games.blurb: An isometric car game with cute cars to unlock, each with its own ability.
games.description: An isometric casual car control with lots of cute car to choose from. Each car has unique abilities and unlocking them makes the game even more fun.

contributions.title: Game Design
contributions.text: The most difficult yet satisfying part of game design for this game was to create the Game Economy system. This game involves a complex economy system that allows the player to buy special cars, fuels and other items to make the game more fun and immersive.
bullets: Designed the game economy and virtual currency system

contributions.title: Game Art
contributions.text: This was the first experience of mine to create a 3d low poly environment. As it was intented for mobile, I had to keep the polycount significantly low. But I love the fact that it turned out decent looking.
bullets: Isometric Environment Design in Low Poly
Texturing the assets, optimized for moblie (Baking)
